recouplingMethod: Direct Wigner3j tensor matrices and Clebsch-Gordan highest-weight vectors; no6j or rational-sum evaluator imported.
conceptualAudit: The Casimir-map spectral inequality gives k<=j. If k=j, equality forces P=alpha I+X with X entirely in tensor rankN.
The unitary time-reversal matrix Y satisfies JY+YJ^T=0, so vectorization XY carries the adjoint rankN representation into total spinN, the fully symmetric2N-qubit sector.
For Hermitian X, the left N-qubit reduction of normalized vec(XY) is X²/Tr(X²)=I/(N+1)+4X/[N(N+2)]. No real-coefficient assumption is used.
The SU2-covariant one-qubit partial trace kills rankN because its target operator space has ranks at mostN−1. It maps I/(N+1) to I/N, giving a pure2N-qubit(N−1)-AC state.
ForN8 the exact positive pure16 identity is impossible. The verified dimension3 witness therefore attains the maximum.
